result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but there is a clear text overlap bug in the 'Popular right now' restaurant card where the delivery time and metadata text collide, plus a few minor polish issues.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the subtitle line shows overlapping/garbled text: '25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' are rendered on top of each other (appears as '25–30rdelivery'), making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the metadata row so the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine tag are separate, non-overlapping elements (e.g., use a flex row with proper spacing or a separator dot between distinct text spans).

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with no visual affordance indicating more content is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll indicator, gradient fade, or peek of the next card so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a red dot badge but no visible label or count, and the icon button may lack an accessible name.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and ensure the badge conveys the count to screen readers.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi'...) is also cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, which can look unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll padding and a fade/peek affordance so the truncated chip reads as scrollable rather than broken.
